title: KEAP1 C151 active site catalysis drives electrophilic signaling to upregulate cytoprotective enzyme expression.
authors: Schnell, Matthew R; Zhai, Tianhua; Ragwan, Edwin R; Jung, Hannah; Zhang, Jiayu; Lagalante, Anthony F; Kung, Yan; Kraut, Daniel A; Huang, Zuyi; Eggler, Aimee L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究KEAP1 C151活性位点对亲电NRF2激活剂的催化反应机制，涉及蛋白-小分子共价结合与基于晶体结构的柔性对接建模，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-配体互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Cells mount a detoxification, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory response to electrophiles, mediated by the NRF2 transcription factor. Electrophilic NRF2 activators are used to treat diverse chronic diseases. While the majority of NRF2 activators target C151 of KEAP1, the primary NRF2 repressor, it is unknown how diverse electrophiles favor this particular cellular cysteine. One hypothesis is that the pK(a) of C151 is lowered by surrounding basic residues, resulting in a higher population of the reactive thiolate. We show that the pK(a) of C151 is 6.9, providing optimal reactivity at physiological pH, using the fluorogenic, thiol-reactive electrophile monobromobimane. Surprisingly, monobromobimane reacts with C151 much faster than with a small-molecule thiolate. NRF2 activators in clinical use and trials (omaveloxolone, bardoxolone methyl, and sulforaphane) readily compete with monobromobimane for C151. A BTB-monobimane crystal structure shows no specific orientation in the active site after covalent addition. A 4D flexible BTB model based on seven crystal structures was used to dock mBBr and NRF2 activators into the active site to obtain poses of the pre-covalent enzyme-substrate complexes. They reveal an active site around C151 that accommodates structurally diverse activators using largely hydrophobic interactions, with a hydrogen bond orienting their electrophilic carbons within  approximately 3-5 A of C151 for a catalytic proximity effect. In addition, our biochemical and docking results suggest a critical catalytic role for hydrogen bonding to the oxygen of an alpha,beta unsaturated carbonyl, which could both increase carbon electrophilicity and stabilize the negative charge in the transition state. Overall, this work suggests enzymatic catalysis is the primary reason that C151 acts as a sensor cysteine for therapeutic, electrophilic NRF2 activators, highly favoring reaction with C151 over other cellular cysteines. The kinetic targeting of electrophiles such as sulforaphane and omaveloxolone to the C151 active site provides an explanation for how electrophilic compounds can be selective pharmacological agents.
abstract_zh: 细胞通过NRF2转录因子介导，对亲电体产生解毒、抗氧化和抗炎反应。亲电性NRF2激活剂用于治疗多种慢性疾病。尽管大多数NRF2激活剂靶向KEAP1（主要的NRF2抑制因子）的C151，但尚不清楚多种亲电体如何优先选择这一特定细胞半胱氨酸。一种假说认为，C151的pK(a)因周围碱性残基而降低，导致反应性硫醇盐的群体增加。我们使用荧光原性、硫醇反应性亲电体单溴双甲醚（monobromobimane）证明，C151的pK(a)为6.9，在生理pH下提供最佳反应性。令人惊讶的是，单溴双甲醚与C151的反应速度远快于与小分子硫醇盐的反应。临床使用和试验中的NRF2激活剂（omaveloxolone、bardoxolone methyl和sulforaphane）能轻易与单溴双甲醚竞争C151。BTB-单溴双甲醚晶体结构显示，共价加成后活性位点中无特定取向。基于七个晶体结构的4D柔性BTB模型用于将mBBr和NRF2激活剂对接入活性位点，以获得共价前酶-底物复合物的构象。这些构象揭示了一个围绕C151的活性位点，主要通过疏水相互作用容纳结构多样的激活剂，并通过氢键将其亲电碳定向在C151约3-5 Å范围内，产生催化邻近效应。此外，我们的生化和对接结果表明，氢键与α,β-不饱和羰基氧的相互作用具有关键催化作用，这可能既增加碳的亲电性，又稳定过渡态中的负电荷。总体而言，这项工作表明酶催化是C151作为治疗性亲电NRF2激活剂传感器半胱氨酸的主要原因，高度优先于其他细胞半胱氨酸与C151反应。亲电体（如sulforaphane和omaveloxolone）对C151活性位点的动力学靶向，解释了亲电化合物如何成为选择性药理学制剂。
